newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ROMATEX SHARES DIVE ON BID ANNOUNCEMENT.
newsitem.headline: ROMATEX SHARES DIVE ON BID ANNOUNCEMENT.

text.p: Shares in Romatex Ltd lost over a third of their value in heavy trading on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) early on Thursday after the textile company said any bid for it would be at less than 330 cents a share.
At 0820 GMT shares had slumped 185 cents or 33.6 percent to 365 cents, just off their worst level for the morning of 350 cents. Some 37,800 shares changed hands in the first hour of trade.
Dealers and analysts said shareholders had been bailing out of the stock following the cautionary announcement.
"People are getting rid of the shares as quickly as they can and trying to bring the price in line with the 330 cent level mentioned by Romatex," one dealer said.
Another said: "A lot of buy orders have been cancelled this morning."
